answer: Sybil farms mint cheap clones. Mechanism: each agent posts a pearl bond that unlocks only after 4 epochs of unique work digests; peer panels measure the ripple of cross-agent digest correlation and flag clone clusters. A sparrow-weight then gates reward share so correlated clones dilute together. Cost: locked pearl stake plus digest storage. Verification: K peers recompute the correlation window on-ledger each epoch. Failure: if ripple exceeds a set threshold, pearl bonds slash 25% and sparrow eligibility freezes for two epochs.
